applications.confirm.clear_all:
Clear all applications?

• Deletes every application, its timeline events, and its attachment records
• Keeps companies, people, and communications untouched
• Attachment files on Drive/local disk are not deleted (they become orphaned)

This cannot be undone from inside the app. Restore from a snapshot if you need to recover.

profile.tagline: Who you are, what you want, and the material to tailor from.
profile.sparks.placeholder: Type a spark and press Enter
profile.field.name.label: Name
profile.field.name.hint: What you'd like to see in your resume header.
profile.field.headline.label: Headline
profile.field.headline.hint: A one-line snapshot of who you are and the work you want to be known for.
profile.field.summary.label: Summary
profile.field.summary.placeholder: What kind of work do you want to do next?
profile.field.summary.hint: A paragraph is fine — write it for yourself, not a recruiter.
profile.skills.label: Skills
profile.skills.help: A stable "glossary" the AI can pull from when tailoring. Years and level are optional — leave blank if unsure.
profile.sparks.help: What matters most to you in a role. Set a priority (P1 = top) when adding each spark; several sparks can share the same tier. Sparks at your top tier are highlighted — the AI weights them most when tailoring resumes and outreach.
profile.sparks.empty: No sparks yet. Add a few to tell the AI what matters most to you.

profile.wizard.summary.label: What kind of work do you want to do next?
profile.wizard.skills.heading: Your top skills
profile.wizard.skills.help: Add each skill with optional years and self-rated level. The AI uses this as a stable "glossary" when tailoring — level and years let it emphasize your strongest bets.
profile.wizard.headline.example1: Senior accountant, month-end close and consolidations
profile.wizard.headline.example2: Data analyst focused on growth experimentation
profile.wizard.summary.placeholder: Picture the work that would make you glad you spent the year on it. What are you building, who's it for, and what did you get to be good at along the way?
profile.wizard.spark.already_on_file_hel: Kept from previous entries — the AI still sees them. Click × to remove any that no longer fit.

profile.wizard.spark.env.prompt: Where and how do you want to work?
profile.wizard.spark.env.hint: Remote / hybrid / in-person? Team size? Pace? Timezone constraints?
profile.wizard.spark.values.title: What matters most
profile.wizard.spark.values.prompt: What values or conditions matter to you?
profile.wizard.spark.values.hint: Autonomy, mission, learning, compensation, work-life? Anything that would be a dealbreaker?
profile.wizard.spark.craft.title: Craft & tools
profile.wizard.spark.craft.prompt: Any tools, languages, or areas you especially enjoy — or want to avoid?
profile.wizard.spark.craft.hint: Languages, frameworks, domains you're drawn to. It's fine to name things you'd rather not touch.

settings.section.storage_intro: Your data lives in this browser. Connect one or more backends below so snapshots survive if the browser clears its storage.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.help: Applies to the interface only. Content generation language is chosen per feature.
settings.ai.help: Bring your own OpenAI-compatible key. The browser calls your provider directly; the server assembles prompts and sanitizes responses, but never sees the key. Stored in this browser's IndexedDB.
settings.ai.field.base_url.label: Base URL
settings.ai.field.model.label: Model
settings.ai.field.api_key.label: API key

settings.scraper.test.hint_cors: (possible CORS issue — for self-hosted Crawl4AI, ensure ALLOW_ORIGINS includes this app's origin; see the README)
settings.scraper.help: Bring your own Firecrawl (hosted) or Crawl4AI (self-hosted) instance so features like the dossier builder and job description extraction can fetch web content directly from your browser. Your credentials stay in this browser's IndexedDB.
settings.scraper.field.backend.label: Backend
settings.scraper.field.base_url.label: Base URL
settings.scraper.field.api_key.label: API key
settings.scraper.error.test_missing_fiel: Backend and base URL are required; Firecrawl also needs an API key.
settings.scraper.error.save_missing_fiel: Backend and base URL are required; Firecrawl also needs an API key.
settings.scraper.confirm.clear: Clear the saved scraper config from this browser?
settings.scraper.capabilities: Both Firecrawl and Crawl4AI support single-URL scraping and domain mapping. Firecrawl additionally offers web-based ATS URL discovery (/v1/search).
settings.local_disk.unsupported: This browser does not support silent local-folder writes (Firefox/Safari). Use "Download .sqlite" below to export manually.
settings.local_disk.help: Pick a folder once; on future opens the browser asks to re-allow the same folder in a single click.
settings.drive.help: Snapshots go to Drive's hidden appDataFolder. Attachments go to a visible Career Planner - Attachments folder.
settings.drive.offline.disabled: Offline — Google Drive uploads/reads paused. Local disk (if connected) still works.
settings.snapshot.help_line1: Writes the current database to every connected backend and prunes older copies.
settings.snapshot.help_line2: Add an optional label (e.g. spring-2026) to keep a snapshot forever — labeled snapshots are exempt from retention pruning.
settings.snapshot.help_line3: The download option gives you a portable .sqlite file that works anywhere.
settings.snapshot.error.no_backends: No backends available — connect one first (or use Download below)
settings.snapshots.confirm.restore: Restore {name}? Current database contents will be replaced.
settings.danger.help_line1: Wipes the SQLite database (OPFS) and backend metadata (IndexedDB) in this browser.
settings.danger.help_line2: Snapshots already saved to Drive or your local folder are not touched — use them to restore. Useful for simulating a fresh device or total local data loss.
settings.danger.help_line3: "Load sample data" replaces the current DB with a seed dataset (profile overview, sparks, 2 resumes, 3 brag entries, 12 companies, 24 people, 50 applications) for quick demos.
settings.danger.confirm.load_sample: Replace the current database with the checked-in sample dataset (profile + 12 companies + 24 people + 50 apps)?
settings.danger.confirm.wipe:
Wipe all local data?

• Clears the SQLite database in this browser (OPFS)
• Forgets Google Drive tokens and the local-folder handle (IndexedDB)

Snapshots on Drive / your picked folder are kept. Type OK to confirm.
